title: With `-X flambda2-meet-strategy=bfs`, `snd p` of a pair built in two branches gives the value of one branch
summary: At `-O2` and `-O3` with `-X flambda2-meet-strategy=bfs`, `f` is simplified to a function that returns 1 whatever `c` is, so `f false 5` is 1 instead of 5. The strategies `dfs` (the default) and `hybrid` are right.
